candidates.name: Semantic Sensor Network Ontology (SSN)
verified_facts: SSN provides an ontology for describing sensors, observations, procedures, features of interest, samples, observed properties and actuators.
Its modular SOSA core supports a wide range of sensing and observation use cases.
semantic_limits: Ontology-level semantic consistency does not establish calibration, observation uncertainty, spatial datum correctness or parcel-specific elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: WaterML 2.0
verified_facts: WaterML 2.0 is an information model for representing and exchanging water-observation data across information systems.
WaterML builds on OGC Observations and Measurements and includes time-series and hydrology-focused parts.
semantic_limits: Hydrology observation exchange semantics do not validate a bare-earth LiDAR parcel sample, its survey lineage or its vertical error budget.
